text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 31 units at 8.5 per day (4 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 30 units at 1.2 per day (26 days on hand). Corvale General holds 128 units at 8.9 per day (14 days on hand). Detailed stock shows Corvale East has two line items totaling 31 units with 2.5 and 4.8 days on hand. Corvale General has two line items with 63.87 and 64.44 units at 14.2 and 14.7 days. Corvale Lakeside has one line item with 30 units at 25.9 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA shortage database shows this drug not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Corvale East is below the two-week target. Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General have sufficient supply to support limited transfers while maintaining at least two weeks on hand. The product is not on the FDA shortage list, so purchasing remains an option.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 13 units from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Transfer 3 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Purchase from ICU Medical Inc. (OTSUKA ICU MEDCL plant) — requires buyer execution.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
